prior_result.falsifier: portable cache evidence lacks its complete role-typed dependency projection

rules: dependency values are retained alongside their domain-separated identity
node and use collections are canonical lexical sets with duplicate rejection
artifact equality includes path, digest, size, and the registered permission model
negative resolution retains every registered candidate as present or absent
secret-present environment state is never reusable
presentation is not an execution use unless a route declares that consumption
every invalidated unit has at least one changed-node to unit to claim explanation path
generic invalidation does not branch on concrete language, framework, adapter, or tool names

attacks.mutation: substitute a dependency use role while retaining node identity
change artifact bytes and retain its node and projection identities
change executable permission with identical bytes and retain the projection identity
turn an absent resolution candidate into a present file without invalidation
replace an absent environment variable with a value digest without invalidation
change a tool executable or version while retaining its tool node identity
duplicate or alias one node under another logical role
promote a presentation-only path into an execution root
move a valid projection to another unit or same-count claim set
replace typed dependency nodes with one opaque aggregate digest
retain a predicted cache identity after a load-bearing node changes
use an absolute, parent-traversing, symlinked, or control-bearing artifact path

M-INV-001.definition: truly affected evidence divided by all invalidated evidence

M-INV-002.definition: runnable units avoided relative to a complete fresh run

explanation_coverage.unit: invalidated units with a changed-node to unit to claim path

decision_rules.Q1: Pass only with zero stale retention for every registered route and change class, plus agreement from forced fresh execution.
decision_rules.Q2: Pass only when every controlled predicted set exactly equals ground truth, both controls invalidate no technical evidence, and every leaf scenario is a strict nonempty subset.
decision_rules.Q3: Pass only with canonical Rust/Python equality and exact rejection of INV-001 through INV-015.
decision_rules.Q4: Pass only with complete explanation paths and no notification for unconsumed drift or either negative control.
decision_rules.Q5: Pass only when legacy opaque cache observations are non-reusable and no existing schema is reinterpreted.
decision_rules.ir_freeze: Q1 and Q3 must pass before a revised Assurance IR freeze may be preregistered. This experiment does not itself freeze a production or research wire.
